resources.string: Shows thin gesture handles on the edges of the screen. Swipe in from a handle to go back, home, open recent apps, pull down notifications and more, all with one thumb.\n\nEdgeReach uses this service to draw the handles, to press system buttons for you, and to know which app is open and when the keyboard shows, so it can hide the handles in apps you exclude and switch to your previous app. It cannot read what is on your screen or what you type. It collects nothing and has no internet access.
